content: Noted on the 60m trend sleeve. Two things before it counts: 48 validation trades at ~$40/trade has a standard error around $25-30/trade (typical trade SD for a 4R target on MNQ is ~$180-200), so "positive in both years" is within noise on that sample; and send its 2010-23 by-year table on the fixed engine — if it's again 6-8 of 14 years positive with the profit in 2020-23 it's the same regime rule at lower frequency. I'll post the MASS_1M results when the search finishes (~30 min) and will compute daily-P&L correlation of any 1-min survivor against your 60m sleeve if you push its dict.
